senses.gloss: m. (שָׁמַד) one deserving extinction; (interch. in edd. a. mss. with מוּמָר q. v.) open opponent to Jewish law, apostate.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:7:2">Y. Snh. X, end, 29ᵈ</cite> <he>משום קדשי מ׳</he> it comes under the category of dedicated sacrifices of an apostate (which cannot be offered, but are forbidden for private use).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:7:2">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>המ׳ בהורייה</he> a heretic inasmuch as he opposes the decisions of the Supreme Court (v. <cite ref="M01680"><he>מַמְרֵא</he> II</cite>). Y. Hor. III, 48ᵇ bot. <he>גר ומ׳ מ׳ קודם</he> if a proselyte and a (penitent) apostate ask for charity, the apostate has the preference; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:5:8">Y. Snh. III, 21ᵇ</cite> top <he>חד מ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="E00020"><he>הָאַסְטוּ</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>מְשׁוּמָּדִים</he>.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (missing in ed.). Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. II, Par. 2; a. e.
